purpose: Teach: 思想家/松山/結城/侍/みえる/回戦/移さ/舞台裏

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、思想家、絶対、影響を受けた、絶対、容疑者、絶対、警察、絶対、捜査中です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're currently investigating a suspect who may have been influenced by ideological material. Thank you for your patience with this process.
lines.style: Professional, measured tone. Even cadence. Slight pause before key details. Respectful closure. The voice of someone accustomed to delivering official information with care.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、松山、絶対、署、絶対、警察、絶対、合同捜査、絶対、進められたんですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: So a joint investigation between the Matsuyama station and prefectural police is underway, then? I appreciate you keeping us informed.
lines.style: Thoughtful, asking for confirmation. Lean forward slightly on the question. Genuine curiosity about the scope of the operation. Warm acknowledgment at the close.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、結城、絶対、市、絶対、警察、絶対、と、絶対、連携、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: That's correct. We're coordinating with Yuki city police on this matter. Thank you for your understanding.
lines.style: Formal but not cold. Clear enunciation on jurisdictional details. Steady tempo. A slight nod in the voice at 'thank you'—sincere, not perfunctory.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、侍、絶対、刀、絶対、を、絶対、使った、絶対、犯罪、絶対、警察、絶対、解明されたんですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: So it was a case involving a sword—a weapon from that historical period. The investigation has made real progress, hasn't it?
lines.style: Slower, more reflective than before. Weight on 'sword'—the gravity of the weapon itself. Tone curious but sobered. Seeking confirmation of progress, not just information.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、防犯カメラに、絶対、みえる、絶対、人物、絶対、警察、絶対、特定中です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We've identified a figure visible in the security footage. The investigation is narrowing in on that person now.
lines.style: Quieter, more direct. Precision on 'identified' and 'narrowing in.' No extra words. The tone of someone who chooses clarity over reassurance. Steady, efficient.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、トーナメントの、絶対、回戦、絶対、警察、絶対、警備、絶対、強化、絶対、されたそうですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I heard the security for the tournament rounds has been increased significantly. That must have been a difficult call to make.
lines.style: Gentle, almost sympathetic question. Pause before 'significantly'—acknowledging the weight of that decision. Curious about the reasoning, not challenging it. Respect underneath.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、押収品、絶対、移さ、絶対、れた、絶対、保管庫、絶対、警察、絶対、警備、絶対、しております、本気for、感謝
lines.en: The seized materials have been transferred and are now under secure guard at our storage facility. We're taking every precaution.
lines.style: Deliberate, slower pace. Emphasis on 'secure' and 'every precaution.' The voice of someone who understands the stakes. No rush. Calm assurance through careful word choice.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、劇場の、絶対、舞台裏、絶対、警察、絶対、調査、絶対、されたんですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The theater's backstage area—I imagine that was thoroughly examined too? This investigation is quite comprehensive.
lines.style: Trailing upward slightly on the first question, seeking confirmation. Slower reflection. Recognition of thoroughness in the tone. Respect for the scope of work, tinged with the weight of what that scope suggests.
